$comment: Schema for a rubric — acceptance criteria for one recruited beta tester and one activity against one diff.

testerId.$comment: Matches id from persona-schema.json / recruited tester object.

activityId.$comment: The beta activity this rubric evaluates.

diffRef.$comment: Git range or commit SHA this rubric was generated for.

id.$comment: Short slug for referencing in evidence and fix proposals.

statement.$comment: Format: [tester] [activity/action] → [observable outcome]. Must be falsifiable under the tester context policy.
statement.example: first-time-cli-user follows README quickstart → can tell a new Claude Code session is required before /code-beta appears

rationale.$comment: One sentence: why this criterion matters for this tester and diff.
rationale.example: The harness is installed by copying command files; Claude Code only discovers them at session start.

evidenceRequired.$comment: What evidence must be produced to pass/fail this criterion.

relevantFiles.$comment: Files most relevant to evaluating this criterion.

role.$comment: Purpose of this activity within the beta run.

criteria.statement: first-time-cli-user follows README quickstart → can tell a new Claude Code session is required before /code-beta appears
criteria.rationale: Command files copied mid-session are not registered until restart; this is a first-run blocker.

criteria.statement: first-time-cli-user hits Unknown command → can use a documented manual fallback without internal knowledge
criteria.rationale: The first self-dogfooding run hit this exact failure mode.
